title: SignalCubeSeriesRow
description: One point of a typed signal series (metric, trace or log derived), tagged with family and klass (03 §3.1). Written by Signalyth over the whole data range, independent of alert windows.

series_id.description: "{service}|{component}|{signal}|{source}"; each part non-empty without |. Writer cross-checks it against the four columns.

component.description: Component from telemetry.metrics for metric series; equals service for trace and log series.

signal.description: Free string without | (contract_changes B). Emitted names: metrics cpu, mem, disk, diskio, net, socket, latency, latency_p{q}, error, rps, workload, a sanitised raw name for other metrics, or "{signal}:{sanitised raw name}" on a per-(service, component) collision; traces latency_p50, latency_p99, error_rate, rps, self_time_p50, self_time_p99; logs log_rate, log_error_rate, tmpl:{template_id}.

klass.description: Signal class: internal, external or context (Signalyth §3.6).

source.description: Telemetry source the series is derived from: metrics, logs or traces (no events).

unit.description: Canonical unit as a free string, e.g. ms, bytes, ratio, 1/s, count, or <unit>/s for counter rates; other metric units unchanged; null when the source gives none.

t_ns.description: Source time in ns (not clock-aligned). Metrics: native observation time; a counter rate is written at the later observation t2 of its pair and the first point is dropped. Traces and logs: start of the epoch-aligned bucket, floor(t / b) * b. Consumers infer the step from t_ns.

value.description: Point value in unit; finite (NaN and ±inf rejected).
